description:
What is This Part?
This is a Premium Replacement Fuel Line
Goes from the Fuel Pump to Return Hard Line.
Comes with 2 Clamps!
OD – 1/2″ / 12mm
ID – 1/4″ / 6mm
Length 18″
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – 18″ Fexible Fuel Line
Qty 2 – Hose Clamps
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1990 All Models
